title: Styles (CSS)
description:
Every chart type takes these `show.style` properties; they cascade from setup
`styles` to the top-level `show.style` to each panel's, key by key, like CSS rules.
See `:help dbdash-css`.

query.sql: SELECT 'North' AS region, 120 AS sales UNION ALL SELECT 'South', 80 UNION ALL SELECT 'East', 95 UNION ALL SELECT 'West', 60

show.title: color, value_style, label_style
show.description:
CSS `color` for the data (`style.color`) and one color per part:
`value_style` (the numbers), `label_style` (the categories).

query.sql: SELECT 'North' AS region, 120 AS sales UNION ALL SELECT 'South', 80 UNION ALL SELECT 'East', 95 UNION ALL SELECT 'West', 60

show.title: background, padding
show.description:
CSS `background-color` (`style.background`) and `padding` (`[1, 2]`: one line
above and below, two columns left and right).

query.sql: SELECT 'North' AS region, 120 AS sales UNION ALL SELECT 'South', 80 UNION ALL SELECT 'East', 95 UNION ALL SELECT 'West', 60

show.title: panel_border, border_style
show.description:
A box around the panel (CSS `border` on the panel, `style.panel_border`: single,
rounded, heavy, double, dashed or ascii) with the title in its top line, colored by
`border_style` (CSS `border-color`).

query.sql: SELECT 'North' AS region, 120 AS sales UNION ALL SELECT 'South', 80 UNION ALL SELECT 'East', 95 UNION ALL SELECT 'West', 60

show.title: border: double, axis_style
show.description:
The plot's own border line (CSS `border-style`: `style.border` single, rounded,
heavy, double, dashed, ascii or none) and the tick labels' color (`axis_style`).

query.sql: SELECT 'North' AS region, 120 AS sales UNION ALL SELECT 'South', 80 UNION ALL SELECT 'East', 95 UNION ALL SELECT 'West', 60

show.title: show_axes: false, border: none
show.description:
CSS `display: none` for parts: `show_axes: false` hides the tick labels and axis
titles, `border: none` the plot frame.

query.sql: SELECT 'North' AS region, 120 AS sales UNION ALL SELECT 'South', 80 UNION ALL SELECT 'East', 95 UNION ALL SELECT 'West', 60

show.title: legend_style, title_style
show.description:
`legend_style` colors the legend labels; `title_style` the title (CSS `font-weight`
and `color` in one value: `"bold underline #e06c75"`).

query.sql: SELECT 'North' AS region, 120 AS sales UNION ALL SELECT 'South', 80 UNION ALL SELECT 'East', 95 UNION ALL SELECT 'West', 60

show.title: justify / align: center
show.description:
Where the chart sits in its cell (CSS `justify-self` / `align-self`): `justify`
start, center, end or stretch; `align` start, center or end.

query.sql: SELECT 'North' AS region, 120 AS sales UNION ALL SELECT 'South', 80 UNION ALL SELECT 'East', 95 UNION ALL SELECT 'West', 60

show.title: title_align: right
show.description: The title's position (CSS `text-align`): left, center or right.

show.title: show_title: false (this title is hidden)
show.description: CSS `display: none` for the title; K still shows this description.

query.sql: SELECT 'North' AS region, 120 AS sales UNION ALL SELECT 'South', 80 UNION ALL SELECT 'East', 95 UNION ALL SELECT 'West', 60

show.title: table: border, padding, striped
show.description:
A table with one line style (`border: rounded`), no cell padding (CSS `padding: 0`
of the cells, Bootstrap `.table-sm`), every other row shaded (CSS
`:nth-child(even)`, Bootstrap `.table-striped`) and NULL in its own color.

query.sql: SELECT 'a long text that wraps inside its column' AS text, 'top' AS a

show.title: table: wrap, vertical_align, align
show.description:
Long cells wrap (CSS `white-space: normal`); a short cell in a tall row sits by
`vertical_align` (top, middle, bottom); `column_list[].align` is CSS `text-align`
for one column. `cell_height: 3` keeps at most three lines per cell (CSS
`line-clamp`); the rest ends with "…".

query.sql: SELECT 'a long text that does not fit in one line' AS text

show.title: table: wrap: false, ellipsis
show.description:
`wrap: false` keeps one line (CSS `white-space: nowrap`) and cuts with `ellipsis`
(CSS `text-overflow`, default "…"); `cell_width` sets every column's width.
